criteria.criterion: The edge routes `/mcp/` straight to the app's `/mcp`, so no Location header is produced for the documented URL. Verified by a structural parse of `rebar.conf.template` asserting an exact-match `location = /mcp/` whose `proxy_pass` carries the path `/mcp`.

An HSTS header with `max-age` >= 31536000 is served on the 443 server, marked `always` so it reaches the unauthenticated 401. Verified by a structural parse asserting `add_header Strict-Transport-Security "..." always;` there.
Each MCP location carries a `proxy_redirect` mapping an `http://` upstream Location to `https://`. Verified by a structural parse that fails if any lacks it.

With the committed `FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS` in force, a `/mcp/` request through the real `streamable_http_app()` yields a Location whose scheme is `https`. Verified by an in-process ASGI test through `ProxyHeadersMiddleware`, with an untrusted-peer negative control asserting `http`, plus a structural check that compose sets it to exactly `*`.

The blue-green deploy path passes that same env to the container it starts: `autodeploy.sh`'s `mcp_run_new` carries `-e FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS='*'`. Verified by reading that function in the committed script.
